subfiles.title: Register sheet for Taihoku reports on the 1936 Independence Day reception
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes two Taihoku communications about the July 4, 1936 official reception and the response to the Director General of Taiwan's congratulatory address.
subfiles.summary: Register entries record a July 8 copy of the Director General address response and a July 7 Independence Day report.
